description: Defines the class Image_Graph_Element, representing a drawable element in a graph with properties like position, style, font, and methods for rendering and styling.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Element
classes.description: Represents a drawable graphical element with properties for position, style, font, and methods for rendering, styling, and managing its appearance on a canvas.

methods.name: setBackground
methods.description: Sets the background fill style of the element.

methods.name: showShadow
methods.description: Enables shadow display around the element with specified color and size.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the element.

methods.name: _getBackground
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the background fill style to the canvas.

methods.name: setBorderStyle
methods.description: Sets the border line style of the element.

methods.name: setBorderColor
methods.description: Sets the border color of the element.

methods.name: _getBorderStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the border line style to the canvas.

methods.name: setLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style of the element.

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.description: Sets the line color of the element.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the line style to the canvas.

methods.name: setFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill style of the element.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color of the element.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Retrieves and applies the fill style to the canvas.

methods.name: _getFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font settings, propagating from parent if not set.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for the element.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size.

methods.name: setFontAngle
methods.description: Sets the font angle or orientation.

methods.name: setFontColor
methods.description: Sets the font color.

methods.name: _clip
methods.description: Enables or disables clipping to the element's coordinates.

methods.name: _setCoords
methods.description: Sets the element's coordinates.

methods.name: _move
methods.description: Moves the element by specified delta values.

methods.name: _setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the element relative to the left boundary.

methods.name: _setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the element relative to the top boundary.

methods.name: setPadding
methods.description: Sets padding around the element.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the element.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the element.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Calculates the left boundary for fill area considering padding.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Calculates the top boundary for fill area considering padding.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Calculates the right boundary for fill area considering padding.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Calculates the bottom boundary for fill area considering padding.

methods.name: _fillWidth
methods.description: Calculates the fill area width.

methods.name: _fillHeight
methods.description: Calculates the fill area height.

methods.name: _displayShadow
methods.description: Draws a shadow around the element (not yet implemented).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes text on the canvas with specified position, alignment, and font.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes and outputs the element to the canvas, including background, border, and shadow.
